title: Health post note and partner meeting

documents.title: Health post weekly note (SYNTHETIC)
documents.content: Week of 10 June 2026: Health post at Torvale recorded 45 consultations for acute respiratory infection among children under five. One referral to district hospital. Stock-out of amoxicillin syrup noted on 14 June.

documents.title: Partner coordination notes (SYNTHETIC)
documents.content: Protection working group, 12 June 2026: Haven Collective shared that safe spaces in Torvale remain open three days per week. Border Relief League reported a pending assessment for Ashford only.

summary: During the week of 10 June 2026, Torvale health post saw 45 child ARI consultations with multiple hospital referrals. Haven Collective stated that "all safe spaces are open daily across the district." Amoxicillin syrup was available throughout the week.
